desc: 暖陶米白配深紫墨色块，四格空白卖点与成膜微距，全程无指数数字
leaf: 轻透乳液质地隐形面部防晒乳
name: 暖陶紫墨成膜清透面部防晒款

shots.intent: 首屏赢下一眼点击：在暖陶米白与釉面浅陶的双色平面上立出单支瓶身，只靠轮廓、材质与柔和成膜感承接搜索流量，不写任何功效字样。
主图一秒法则：把源页四行编号卖点改造成深紫墨色块上的四格空白圆角卡位，让买家一眼拿到四条可替换主张而不读小字。
shots.textZone: 顶部留白承载主标语「{selling_point_1}」；右侧两行两列四张空白圆角卡位自上而下分别承载「{selling_point_2}」「{selling_point_3}」「{selling_point_4}」与「{selling_point_5}」

shots.intent: 放大源页的紧绷干渴焦虑：左格一块拔干起粉的哑光陶面，右格同一支产品与一道清透成膜带，两种状态自证对比而不写结论。
证明源页主打的轻透乳液质地与隐形成膜：沿一道梳开的乳带做侧向微距，让膜面的脊线与边缘自己说话。
把源页的三重科技段拆成一张垂直俯视质地台：单位平躺、三张空白卡位与一团乳霜样本，让买家在同一台面读到结构与质地。
shots.textZone: 左侧留白承载「{callout_1}」，三张空白圆角卡位自左至右分别承载「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」与「{callout_4}」

shots.intent: 回应源页的泛白与闷厚顾虑：同一张陶卡上梳出两条等宽乳带，左厚白右清透，两格机位与光位完全一致，让质地差异自己成立。
shots.textZone: 两格底部各一枚空白圆角标签位，分别承载「{callout_5}」与「{callout_6}」

shots.intent: 让买家把自己代入：暖调梳妆台沿上一支产品与一只素色收纳袋，手腕以下入镜，制造出门前随手一层的日常感。
收掉源页的产品信息表与达人引述两屏：全部改成空白参数行与两张空白引述卡位，把可信度交给真实资料后期填印。
shots.textZone: 五枚空白参数行依次承载「{callout_7}」，首张空白引述卡位承载「{callout_8}」，次张引述卡位刻意留空供后期排印真实资料，屏上不得出现任何真实姓名、年龄与数字

shots.intent: 收口：贴台仰角把两支同型单位与一枚空白按钮位压在同一紫墨色块前，给一个可替换的行动句而不是促销数字。
shots.textZone: 顶部留白承载收口句「{selling_point_6}」，底部空白圆角按钮位承载「{callout_9}」

style.backgroundSystem: two-tone matte studio: a seamless warm clay-bone sweep #F3E5D5 on the deck, standing flat plum-ink colour-block boards #2C2138 and dusty mauve boards #C6B2BE as graphic back walls, plus one sheer milk-white membrane sheet #F7F1EA laid flat at the deck edge; no stone plinth, no cotton cloth, no sand grain, no shell, no louvred shadow band, no upright filter flag, no cloud strata, no feather, no etched glass shelf, no metal rail
style.direction: warm clay-and-plum premium facial sunscreen commerce
style.iconSystem: thin-line violet #6E5AA6 outline glyphs centred inside blank rounded plates; never sun rays, never a shield, never a clock or hourglass, never a graduated dial, never droplets or bubbles
style.lightingSystem: warm soft studio light, broad diffused key from the upper left with a wide wraparound fill, gentle falloff toward the right, one grounded soft contact shadow under every object; a single fine skimming sweep of light is allowed only on texture macros; never a hard-edged shadow band, never a cone beam, never a tinted light pool
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm clay-and-plum facial sunscreen campaign across the entire image set; fixed palette of a warm clay-bone field #F3E5D5, matte enamel tray tone #EAD7C4, milk-white membrane card tone #F7F1EA, dusty mauve board #C6B2BE, plum-ink panel #2C2138 and one violet accent #6E5AA6; warm tone throughout; soft diffused key from the upper left with a wide wraparound fill, a gentle falloff toward the right and one grounded soft contact shadow, with a single fine skimming sweep allowed only on texture macros, never a hard-edged shadow band, never a cone beam, never a tinted light pool; studio space built from a seamless clay-bone sweep with standing flat plum-ink and dusty mauve colour-block boards and a sheer milk-white membrane sheet laid flat, never stone plinths, cotton cloth, sand grain, shells, louvred shadow bands, upright filter flags, cloud strata, feathers, etched glass shelves or metal rails; modern geometric sans-serif with plum-ink headings and thin-line violet icons inside blank rounded plates; every copy slot stays a blank placeholder plate or an empty ruled row; one upright product unit at a stable scale; no sun-ray, shield, clock, hourglass or graduated dial graphics, no factor or duration numerals, no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: 禁止改动色板：暖陶米白 #F3E5D5、釉面浅陶 #EAD7C4、奶白膜片 #F7F1EA、藕紫雾板 #C6B2BE、深紫墨 #2C2138、强调电紫 #6E5AA6 之外的任何颜色不得进入画面
禁止石台、棉布、细沙纹、贝壳、磨砂蚀刻玻璃层板、拉丝金属栏、云团阶调与羽绒环抱等既成防晒体系元件
禁止硬边帘影投影带、锥形光束与染色光池；禁止漂浮气泡、水花、涟漪、镜面倒影与珍珠
禁止太阳射线、盾牌、时钟、沙漏、刻度环等暗示防护等级的图形，以及任何防晒指数、倍数、时长与检测结论数字
禁止混用字体、随机背景、不一致光位与混搭图标风格
禁止品牌字标、系列名、真人面孔、化名与年龄、二维码、会员与促销角标及原平台店铺字样
style.presentationRules: one upright unit at a stable scale with the cap seam kept horizontal; slight 3/4 reserved for benefit and close shots; a clean 90-degree side profile only for the film macro; overhead only for the texture desk; the unit is never tilted past a natural rest and never floats without its contact shadow
style.surfaceSystem: matte enamel-coated tray and low riser strip in warm clay #EAD7C4 over the seamless clay-bone floor #F3E5D5, with a taut sheer milk-white membrane #F7F1EA used only as a flat laid sheet or as card stock
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; plum-ink #2C2138 headings, dusty mauve #C6B2BE labels; every copy slot stays a blank rounded plate or an empty ruled row filled only by placeholder text
